correctness.rationale: For the proposed numerator, p_lambda(z)=z^n-sigma(1-2 lambda/(L+mu)), so every root has modulus at most ((L-mu)/(L+mu))^(1/n), with equality at both spectral endpoints. For every numerator of degree less than n, the monic characteristic polynomials satisfy L p_mu(0)-mu p_L(0)=-sigma(L-mu); the product-of-roots bound therefore forces the same lower bound. The recurrence proof independently gives the same rate in the time domain.

value.rationale: The result provides an exact constructive benchmark for an infinite natural family of periodic and antiperiodic quadratic tracking problems at every degree n>=4. It closes the gap between a general lower bound and explicit attainment for this structured family, and yields a simple implementable recurrence. The claim is not an arbitrary numerical slice and does not overgeneralize to all unit-circle models.
